cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Surface Strip
cards.wordChoiceSkill: use one surface word on paper
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable washi tape word-choice card for revising one fictional tidepool lab sentence with a clearer paper-only surface word: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside blank paper and one pretend washi strip, then keep every example broad and fictional: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: choose one plain tidepool word, then replace it with a precise noun, clear verb, or useful describing word: ____________________.
cards.plainWordPrompt: Plain word: write a bland word from the shell-note sentence, such as thing, moved, nice, or place: ____________________.
cards.preciseNounPrompt: Precise noun: choose one invented tidepool object such as shell dial, bead tray, pool tag, or paper bell: ____________________.
cards.clearVerbPrompt: Clear verb: replace moved with a verb the reader can picture, such as nudged, lined up, tilted, or slid: ____________________.
cards.describerPrompt: Useful describer: add one surface word, such as rippled, smooth, dotted, or folded, only if it sharpens the picture: ____________________.
cards.sentenceSwapPrompt: Sentence swap: rewrite The timekeeper moved the thing with sharper tidepool words: ____________________.
cards.soundShapePrompt: Sound and shape check: read the revised line on paper and mark the word that makes the sentence rhythm clearer: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the revised fictional tidepool sentence in its clearest form: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: circle one stronger tidepool word and write only the final line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: make another tidepool lab sentence clearer by changing one plain word: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Trimmed Wake
cards.wordChoiceSkill: tighten a sentence with fewer words
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable washi tape word-choice card for tightening one fictional ferry revision sentence while keeping the meaning clear on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out this card with blank paper and a pretend ferry draft strip, then invite one short fictional revision: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: find a wordy ferry sentence, cross out extra words, and choose one exact noun or verb to carry more meaning: ____________________.
cards.plainWordPrompt: Plain word: write the wordy phrase from the ferry line, such as the sign that was on the deck or did a change: ____________________.
cards.preciseNounPrompt: Precise noun: choose one exact ferry noun such as draft sign, dock tag, margin rope, or folded oar marker: ____________________.
cards.clearVerbPrompt: Clear verb: replace did a change with adjusted, trimmed, straightened, tucked, or another clear action: ____________________.
cards.describerPrompt: Useful describer: add one describing word only if it earns its space, such as narrow, neat, tilted, or crisp: ____________________.
cards.sentenceSwapPrompt: Sentence swap: change The ferry helper did a change to the sign that was on the deck into a tighter sentence: ____________________.
cards.soundShapePrompt: Sound and shape check: read both versions on paper and mark the shorter line that still sounds complete: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the tightened fictional ferry sentence with no extra filler words: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw a small slash through one extra word, then copy the tightened line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: tighten one new ferry sentence by trading a long phrase for one clear word: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Verb Lift
cards.wordChoiceSkill: choose a verb before adding describing words
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable washi tape word-choice card for strengthening one fictional museum-label sentence by choosing the verb first: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card beside blank paper and a pretend label strip, then ask for a fictional tower-museum action: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: choose the action word before adding any describing words, so the clue-label sentence moves clearly: ____________________.
cards.plainWordPrompt: Plain word: write a weak action from the label sentence, such as put, made, got, or went: ____________________.
cards.preciseNounPrompt: Precise noun: choose one tower-museum noun such as label rail, clue drawer, pointer card, or display tag: ____________________.
cards.clearVerbPrompt: Clear verb: replace the weak action with arranged, lifted, tucked, balanced, or another verb that shows the movement: ____________________.
cards.describerPrompt: Useful describer: after the verb works, add one describer such as narrow, gleaming, tiny, or tilted if it helps: ____________________.
cards.sentenceSwapPrompt: Sentence swap: rewrite The clue keeper put the label by the case with a verb that does more work: ____________________.
cards.soundShapePrompt: Sound and shape check: tap the verb on paper and mark whether the sentence sounds cleaner before or after the describer: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the revised fictional tower-museum sentence with the clear verb leading the action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: underline the verb first, then write one revised label sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: revise another clue-label sentence by choosing the verb before adding a describer: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Choice Pair
cards.wordChoiceSkill: compare two word choices on paper
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable washi tape word-choice card for comparing two fictional compass-craft word choices before revising the sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: give the writer blank paper with two pretend washi choice strips and keep the compass-craft scene invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: write two possible words, compare what each one shows, then choose the word that fits the sentence job: ____________________.
cards.plainWordPrompt: Plain word: write the vague compass-craft word you want to replace, such as tool, made, good, or part: ____________________.
cards.preciseNounPrompt: Precise noun: choose two possible craft nouns, such as paper needle, bead marker, fold guide, or compass card: ____________________.
cards.clearVerbPrompt: Clear verb: compare two verbs, such as balanced and dropped or traced and marked, then choose the clearer action: ____________________.
cards.describerPrompt: Useful describer: test one describer, such as steady, bent, bright, or careful, and keep it only if it changes the picture: ____________________.
cards.sentenceSwapPrompt: Sentence swap: rewrite The crafter made the tool twice, once with each word choice: ____________________.
cards.soundShapePrompt: Sound and shape check: read both compass-craft versions on paper and mark the line that sounds smoother: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the revised fictional compass-craft sentence with the chosen word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: circle A or B on the two choice strips, then copy the chosen sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: compare two words for one new compass-craft sentence before writing the final line: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Final Line
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable washi tape word-choice card for choosing and copying one final revised fictional boardwalk sentence on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the card beside blank paper and a pretend booklet strip, then frame the boardwalk moment as fully fictional: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: revise one boardwalk sentence, choose the clearest version, and copy it carefully as the final line: ____________________.
cards.plainWordPrompt: Plain word: write the plain boardwalk word or phrase, such as closed it, nice booklet, went over, or small thing: ____________________.
cards.preciseNounPrompt: Precise noun: choose one exact boardwalk noun such as booklet clasp, thread loop, page rail, or promise slip: ____________________.
cards.clearVerbPrompt: Clear verb: replace closed it or went over with clasped, folded, sealed, tucked, or another visible action: ____________________.
cards.describerPrompt: Useful describer: add one useful word such as neat, warm, narrow, or bright only if it helps the reader picture the page: ____________________.
cards.sentenceSwapPrompt: Sentence swap: rewrite The helper closed it at the boardwalk stand with sharper nouns and verbs: ____________________.
cards.soundShapePrompt: Sound and shape check: read the revised line on paper and mark the place where the sentence rhythm feels smoothest: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the clearest revised fictional boardwalk sentence as the line you would keep: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy only the final line and underline the word that improved it most: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: choose one plain boardwalk word, replace it, and copy the revised line on paper: ____________________.
